recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-15959 unless a future review identifies a stale generated artifact outside the active source.
issue_request: FHIR-15959 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification PA issue for FHIR-core Organization. It asked that invariant org-1 refer to "identifier" rather than "id" while preserving the existing FHIRPath expression, and that misspellings of "Neuclear" on the Organization page be corrected to "Nuclear".
initial_application: The issue was applied before this reconciliation. Commit 24a0db08528f365794be109bd33089f696be0772 changed the then-authoritative Organization spreadsheet invariant from "name or an id" to "name or an identifier" as part of FHIR-15959/FHIR-18822, and commit 1e3777e999c80221bb9136739b3b8639a128668a corrected the Organization notes examples from "Neuclear" to "Nuclear". The old spreadsheet is no longer present; the active StructureDefinition carries the corrected invariant.
additional_context: FHIR-18822 is the companion Published issue that requested the same org-1 identifier wording and a related Organization.identifier requirements update; it has already been separately reconciled on the combined branch by commit 02efe6d96ff1083e36dc0b45c6dfc436701760dc. source/fhir.ini lists Organization as an active PA-owned approved resource. Zulip and PA Confluence evidence confirm the requested wording and spelling scope.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/organization/structuredefinition-Organization.xml already says "The organization SHALL at least have a name or an identifier" for org-1, and source/organization/organization-notes.xml already spells the examples as "Nuclear Medicine".

related_jiras.note: Companion Published PA issue that requested the same org-1 identifier wording and a related Organization.identifier requirements wording update; it is already separately represented on the combined branch.
